Name: Animated Inventory Tabs - Starry Night
Author: ThaeloBlu
Description:
Hello! I absolutely love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15329]Starry Night Interface[/url] mod. But then I found NoFogBob's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10644]Animated Inventory Tabs[/url] and was blown away at how good it was. Unfortunately, I couldn't really use them together, since the colors clashed. So with a little guidance from NoFogBob, I was able to create a recolor of their mod to match the Starry Night Interface! Now I can use 2 of the best UI mods at the same time, and so can you! This is the first mod I've actually published, so I hope you enjoy!

[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#3c78d8][size=5]~What This Mod Does~[/size][/color][/font]
[/b][/center][list]
[*]Animates all of the [b]Inventory Menu[/b] icons [size=1]([i]except Exit Game and the Skills icon, which is the farmer's sprite[/i])[/size]
[*]Animates all of the icons on the [b]Collections[/b] tab
[*]Animates the farmer skill icons on the [b]Skills[/b] tab [size=1]([i]Custom Skills added by other mods will not be animated[/i])[/size]
[*]Animates the Money and Clock icons on the [b]Load Save[/b] screen.
[*]Adds more information to the [b]Collections[/b] icons to better describe what they represent
﻿- To disable this, go to the mod's page in-game using GMCM and click the toggle - Or edit the [i]config.json[/i] and change [font=Courier New]DeluxeCollectionTabsTooltips[/font] from "[i]true[/i]" to "[i]false[/i]"[*]All recolored for use with the [b]Starry Night Interface[/b] mod
[*][i]Currently compatible with Stardew Valley versions 1.5.4, 1.5.5 and 1.5.6. Other versions have not been tested.[/i]
[/list]
[center][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#3c78d8][size=5]~Installation~[/size][/color][/font][/b][/center][list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15329]Starry Night Interface[/url]﻿  [size=1]([i]technically optional, but this recolor is made to match that mod[/i])[/size]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ [size=1](GMCM - [i]optional if you want to change mod configs in-game without editing the config.json[/i][/size])
[*]Unzip this mod file, then copy or move it into the [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder
[*]Run the game through SMAPI
[*]Send Happy Thoughts to ConcernedApe  [size=1]([i]okay, this one's optional too, but you should still do it![/i])[/size]
[/list]
[color=#3c78d8][size=5][center][b][font=Comic Sans MS]~Uninstallation~[/font][/b][/center][/size][/color][center]Just delete this mod's folder from the [b]\Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder[/center]
[b][color=#3c78d8][size=5][center][font=Comic Sans MS]~Supported Mods~[/font][/center][/size][/color][/b]This mod is supported by and/or designed to be used with these mods:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15329]Starry Night Interface[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10763]Wallet Items - Animated and Described[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2536]Mod Update Menu[/url]  [size=1](﻿NOTE: Get the unofficial update from this [url=https://github.com/Dphill10827/StardewMods/tree/master/ModUpdateMenu]GitHub page[/url]﻿)[/size]
[/list]These mods are seen in the images:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5495]Colorful Braids With Flowers[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15123]Moolah Money Mod[/url]﻿
[/list][b][color=#3c78d8][size=5][center][font=Comic Sans MS]~Notes~[/font][/center][/size][/color][/b]Changes from Bob's Original Mod:
﻿- Changed several icons to match their Starry Night counterparts.
﻿- Made small changes to a few Collections icon descriptions.
﻿- Changed some code formatting and commented descriptions.
﻿- Added a Description for the config in the GMCM menu.
This mod edits part of the Cursors.xnb file and may be incompatible with mods that change the [b]same[/b] icons, or the Collections tab text. Mods that change the mouse cursor will still work. Notably, you will still have the cool mouse cursor changes from the Starry Night Interface.

Downloads.Description:
- Main mod file. Make sure to download and install the required mods first.
- If also downloading the original Animated Inventory Tabs mod, do not use both mods at the same time. Choose one.
- Check the Description page for full details.
